name: digital-dm-screen
description: A tiling digital DM screen for tabletop RPGs
author: Travus
//license: Split on purpose — the code is mine, the SRD text under src/renderer/src/data/ is not. See LICENSE.md.
//homepage: Required by the .deb target. Point this at the real repo when there is one.

scripts.//check: The one command to run before pushing. CI runs the three parts separately, so a failure names itself.
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck

//pinned.vite: Held at 7.x — electron-vite 5 peers on vite ^5 || ^6 || ^7.
//pinned.@vitejs/plugin-react: Held at 5.x — 6.x requires vite 8, which electron-vite 5 rejects.
//pinned.zustand: Held at 4.x — v5 dropped the useStore(selector, equalityFn) overload the initiative/party sync uses.
//pinned.react: Held at 18.x — nothing here needs 19, and the upgrade buys no fixes we care about.
//pinned.typescript: Held at 5.x — 7.x is the native rewrite; not worth the risk for this project yet.
